title: Unique birthday.
text:
A fabulous experience for all attendees: The room is beautiful, the atmosphere very cute, the live orchestra sounds tremendously good, and the price is accessible!
We celebrate an unforgettable birthday!
author: M_nica_G2013

title: Fantastic hidden gem in Barcelona.
text: Fantastic venue. Beautiful dance hall in a hidden corner of Barcelona. Fantastic atmosphere, music, and staff. Although the dance hall has been around over 100 years, it oy recently reopened last year.
author: M4728OPdavea

title: Wonderful experience
text: When we got there we needed a barcode which was not supplied by this site however the place was gracious and let us in.
author: Lysa_S

title: A change of scenery guaranteed
text:
Beautifully retro and elegant..transported to another time..splendid!
Surprising at first...but very quickly charmed by this elegant and picturesque place...unforgettable!
I put June 2023..but it was much longer ago…
author: 791lysel

title: Beautiful retro dance hall
text: Unfortunately, we had problems getting in and were only allowed in as an exception. The reason: They don't work with this agency. Tickets are only available via the venue's website. But the visit is definitely worth it. Greetings from Pedro Almodovar...
